text: {"text":"Approve only a canary deployment, and require stale-read telemetry before broader rollout. What changes, what improved, what remains unknown? The proposed update changes the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. In the available evidence, a twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests. However, the benchmark did not measure stale-read incidence. This separates a benchmark observation from an unmeasured outcome and makes the practical consequence appropriately narrow here."}
